title: extractions
description: Consumer contract for Delta table metadata_queue, written by MetadataExtractionPipeline. Not a medallion gold table. The physical name stays metadata_queue. Consumers must ignore unknown properties.

url.description: Page URL the metadata was extracted from.

title.description: Item title. The pipeline writes an empty string when the item has none.

entities.description: JSON object encoded as text. The pipeline holds a dict in memory and json.dumps it before the Delta write, because an empty struct cannot be written as Parquet. Consumers parse the string. An empty extraction is "{}".

date.description: Partition column YYYY-MM-DD added by LakehouseManager. Not a writer field. metadata_queue rows do not carry the default date source fields, so this is the UTC day of the write unless a row already has a valid date.
